Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

BiHeat 0.1.0

First release.

  • biheat() draws two matrices of the same shape in one heatmap, splitting every cell along a diagonal.
  • breed(), incubate() and plot() expose the same drawing as a three-stage lifecycle around a clutch object, which carries the aligned matrices, a tidy long form, and comparison statistics.
  • switch_sides(), straighten(), bothways() and comes_out() operate clutch-in, clutch-out.
  • geom_biheat() draws split cells as a ggplot2 layer. Each triangle carries its own gradient, leaving the fill scale free for other layers.
  • bi_legend() returns the paired-palette key as a standalone grob.
  • palettes() bundles a pair of gradient palettes; theme_biheat() supplies a minimal heatmap theme.
  • Three vignettes: vignette("biheat") for the clutch, alignment, and the lifecycle, vignette("styling") for the rendering options, and vignette("geom-biheat") for the ggplot2 layer.

Developed by Gilles Colling.
